subject.title: [security] Generated VNC password is printed to stdout by default

question: Should `crabbox vnc` stop printing generated desktop credentials by default and require an explicit private-terminal reveal path?
rationale: The source evidence supports a generated-credential exposure concern, but the current CLI and docs intentionally expose the value for manual VNC login, so maintainers must choose the security boundary and compatibility path.

options.title: Redact by default with explicit reveal
options.body: Match the WebVNC precedent by hiding generated credentials in default stdout and adding or documenting an explicit unsafe reveal path for private terminals.

options.title: Keep documented stdout behavior
options.body: Treat the current password output as accepted trusted-operator behavior and update security or docs language to make that boundary explicit.

options.title: Use a different handoff design
options.body: Preserve manual usability through a non-stdout credential handoff or one-time reveal flow before changing the default.

recommendation.title: Redact by default with explicit reveal
recommendation.body: Match the WebVNC precedent by hiding generated credentials in default stdout and adding or documenting an explicit unsafe reveal path for private terminals.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns the recent VNC/WebVNC credential-output history and the existing WebVNC secure-default precedent.
